one_line: Ahom king of Upper Assam who expanded his realm into Chutia territories and reshaped the kingdom’s frontier administration in the early 16th century.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, tall and lean, wiry but dignified build
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, light brown Assamese-Tai complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, thin moustache and short trimmed beard along the jaw, eyes slightly narrow and intense, default expression calm, strategic and watchful with a hint of stern resolve
appearance.hair: straight black hair pulled into a compact topknot at the crown, sides neatly combed back, wrapped with a deep indigo Tai-style headcloth band that sits like a slim turban ring and is knotted at the back with one short tail
appearance.costume: he wears a long-sleeved, thigh-length cotton cheleng tunic dyed muted ivory-white with a subtle woven texture, fastened with small ties at the side, over which is draped a rich mustard-gold patolu-style silk shawl diagonally from left shoulder to right hip with thin red and green border stripes and fine geometric motifs; his lower body is wrapped in a deep brick-red cotton dhoti-style garment, pleated in front and reaching to the ankles, tied securely at the waist with a dark brown fabric belt, and he has simple brown leather sandals on his feet; jewellery is restrained but royal—two slim gold bangles on each wrist, a short gold necklace with a small disc pendant, and small round gold ear-studs; an additional narrow off-white cotton scarf with red border is looped around his neck and trails behind slightly to give movement.
appearance.signature: a medium-length steel sword of the type used by Ahom nobles, with a gently curving single-edged blade, plain iron guard, and a wooden hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried in a simple brown leather scabbard slung diagonally across his back so the hilt rises over his left shoulder, one hand often resting lightly on it as a symbol of frontier authority.

ref_desc: Suhungmung Dihingia Raja has an oval light-brown face with a moustache and short beard, black hair in an indigo-banded topknot, ivory cheleng tunic, mustard-gold patterned shawl, brick-red dhoti, subtle gold jewellery and a dark-brown-hilted curved sword on his back.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style model sheet of Suhungmung Dihingia Raja: a tall, lean king in his early 40s with an oval light-brown Assamese-Tai face, high cheekbones, straight nose, thin moustache and short jaw beard, eyes slightly narrow and intense in a calm, strategic expression. His straight black hair is tied into a compact topknot at the crown, wrapped by a slim deep indigo headcloth band knotted at the back. He wears a long-sleeved, thigh-length ivory-white cotton cheleng tunic with subtle woven texture, side fastenings and modest neckline, over which a rich mustard-gold patolu-style silk shawl with thin red and green borders and fine geometric motifs drapes diagonally from left shoulder to right hip. His lower body is clothed in a deep brick-red cotton dhoti-style wrap, pleated at the front and reaching the ankles, secured by a dark brown fabric belt at the waist, and he stands in simple brown leather sandals; an additional narrow off-white cotton scarf with red border loops around his neck and trails slightly behind. Show two slim gold bangles on each wrist, a short gold necklace with a small disc pendant, and small round gold ear-studs. His signature weapon is a medium-length gently curving steel sword with plain iron guard and a wooden hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, in a brown leather scabbard slung diagonally across his back so the hilt rises over his left shoulder, one hand resting lightly on it. Use an anime action-historical style and keep the dominant colours ivory-white, mustard-gold, brick-red, deep indigo and dark brown.
